title: You Won’t Believe What Obama Says In This Video! 😉
summary: A BuzzFeed PSA from 2018 in which a deepfaked Barack Obama, voiced by Jordan Peele, warns about fake video before revealing the trick. It is a one-minute demonstration of AI face and voice manipulation.
why: Used as an early, widely seen example of deepfakes in discussions of fake video and its risks.

quote.text: It's already possible to produce fairly accurate fake video of people saying things, in their own voice
